title.value: CO PTI DICE: Offline Constrained Reinforcement Learning via Stationary Distribution Correction Estimation
title.justification: The title is stated at the beginning of the paper and is reiterated in multiple places throughout the document.
title.quote: CO PTI DICE: O FFLINE C ONSTRAINED R EINFORCEMENT L EARNING VIA S TATIONARY D ISTRIBUTION C ORRECTION E STIMATION

analysis.description: This paper presents an offline constrained reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm named COptiDICE, which optimizes the policy for constrained decision-making by estimating stationary distribution corrections.

type.justification: The paper describes experimental results showing the performance of the proposed algorithm COptiDICE in terms of constraint satisfaction and reward-maximization compared to baseline algorithms.
type.quote: Experimental results show that COptiDICE attains better policies in terms of constraint satisfaction and return-maximization, outperforming baseline algorithms.

name.justification: The paper focuses on offline constrained reinforcement learning, which is a subfield of reinforcement learning.
name.quote: We consider the offline constrained reinforcement learning (RL) problem, in which the agent aims to compute a policy that maximizes expected return while satisfying given cost constraints, learning only from a pre-collected dataset.

name.justification: The paper specifically targets constrained decision-making in reinforcement learning, as indicated multiple times in the document focusing on constraint satisfaction methods.
name.quote: Our algorithm, COptiDICE, directly estimates the stationary distribution corrections of the optimal policy with respect to returns, while constraining the cost upper bound, with the goal of yielding a cost-conservative policy for actual constraint satisfaction.

name.justification: The application of offline reinforcement learning methods is central to this work, focusing on offline data and analysis.
name.quote: Offline RL (also known as batch RL) algorithms sidestep this problem and perform policy optimization solely from a set of pre-collected data.

name.justification: COptiDICE is introduced as the main algorithmic contribution of this paper, applying to offline constrained reinforcement learning.
name.quote: Our algorithm, Offline Constrained Policy Optimization via stationary DIstribution Correction Estimation (COptiDICE)...

is_contributed.justification: COptiDICE is the novel method proposed by the authors of the paper.
is_contributed.quote: In this paper, we present an offline constrained RL algorithm that optimizes the state-action stationary distribution directly, rather than the Q-function or the policy.

is_executed.justification: The paper includes numerical experiments showcasing the implementation of COptiDICE.
is_executed.quote: Experimental results show that COptiDICE attains better policies in terms of constraint satisfaction and return-maximization, outperforming baseline algorithms.

is_compared.quote: Experimental results show that COptiDICE attains better policies in terms of constraint satisfaction and return-maximization, outperforming baseline algorithms.
